title: min width 1 5x field height
name: Minimum width 1.5× field height — Spectrum
rule: Standard and quiet text fields: minimum width 1.5× field height.
pass_when: Standard and quiet text-field width is at least 1.5× the field height.
fail_when: Standard or quiet text field narrower than 1.5× height.
overview: Standard and quiet text fields need minimum width of 1.5× field height.
apply_when: Sizing Spectrum standard or quiet text fields.
not_when: Standard or quiet text fields narrower than 1.5× their height.
agent_hint: Set standard and quiet text-field width to at least 1.5× field height.
description: For Spectrum standard and quiet text fields, minimum width is 1.5× the field height so the control stays usable to hit and to read. Pass when standard and quiet text-field width is at least 1.5× height. Fail when a standard or quiet text field is narrower than 1.5× its height and becomes hard to use.
